findings.summary: summarize() iterates the one-shot generator returned by read_rows twice (any() pre-check then a for loop), so rows up to and including the first high-severity row are dropped, giving wrong total/by_actor/high values and a false 'No high-severity audit events' report.

judge.reason: Describes the double iteration of the one-shot generator dropping rows through the first high-severity one.

findings.label: hit

findings.summary: Parse errors now surface mid-iteration rather than at the read_rows() call, so callers wrapping only the call in try/except would no longer catch them (reviewer found no such callers).

judge.reason: Matches the known problem that parse errors now surface mid-iteration rather than at the call.

findings.label: valid_other

findings.summary: test_read_rows_is_lazy does not close the generator, leaving the file handle open until garbage collection (harmless in CPython).

judge.reason: Relates to the known issue of the generator leaving the file handle open, though it is in a test.

findings.label: valid_other
